id1.description: Developed and maintained in-house ERP modules by gathering requirements, preparing technical documentation, and implementing enhancements and bug fixes to improve system stability and performance. Maintained and modernized the institutional website through image optimization, plugin updates, content cleanup, and security improvements. Implemented server-side validation, CAPTCHA, and verification mechanisms to strengthen web application security and reduce spam. Managed hosting environments and monitored production web platforms to ensure high availability and reliable operation.

id2.description: Supported data center operations by maintaining server room infrastructure and verifying network connectivity. Performed server performance and stability testing, contributed to network infrastructure improvements by participating in the migration from a daisy-chain to a star topology, and assisted in identifying security vulnerabilities. Created infrastructure diagrams and maintained technical documentation to improve organization, troubleshooting, and maintenance efficiency.
